from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u050/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    lines = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background:
            lines.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(vals)) == 1 and vals[0] != background:
            lines.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in lines:
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
f=progdir/'task-a04f8797.py'; f.write_text(program)
